scope: ASCII renderer engineering checks (no terminal needed)
checks: the glyph table holds all 95 printable characters, each 6-circle shape vector normalized per dimension
glyphs are picked by shape: blank is a space, a vertical stroke a bar, a horizontal stroke a dash, ink at the bottom an underscore, a filled cell a dense glyph ('Q')
directional contrast darkens the components next to a brighter neighbour, sharpening the boundary
a face is the same for the same person and state, differs between people and worlds, and changes with mood, stress and sleep pressure
age shapes the look: grey hair and lines when older, a rounder face with bigger eyes when young
